column1: # lib.io + lib.util + lib.log batch: owner <TAB> kind <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# Scope: com.noblemaster.lib.io (40 methods + 9 fields), com.noblemaster.lib.util (7 methods +
# 1 field) and com.noblemaster.lib.log (5 methods). Evidence per symbol:
# GameFile (the single point every resource goes through, including the v5 mod override):
#   a = FileLocation, b = the relative name -> location / name. a() delegates to the FileHandle
#   -> exists ; b() answers which libGDX Files.FileType the path maps to -> getFileType ;
#   c() returns the resolved path string -> getPath ; d() returns the FileHandle itself (the
#   method every caller uses, .read()/.readBytes()/.exists()) -> getFileHandle ; the static e()
# DataFileResolver: a = the external user directory prefix -> externalDir ; a(String) resolves an
#   internal (data/) file -> getInternal ; b(String) resolves an external one -> getExternal ;
# FileUtils: a(File,File) is the streaming file copy (FileChannel.transferTo in 64K chunks)
#   -> copyFile ; b(File,File) recurses over a directory, copying files and descending into
# DataReader/DataWriter + their stream implementations: the interface order and the
#   DataInputStream/DataOutputStream calls in StreamDataReader/StreamDataWriter are one-to-one:
#   a() -> readString (a null flag, a short chunk count, then 21845-char UTF chunks) / writeString
#   (same chunking, because DataOutputStream.writeUTF is limited to 65535 bytes per string);
#   counterparts; g() -> close (reader) ; a()/b() -> flush/close (writer). AbstractDataReader/
#   AbstractDataWriter add nothing, they only mark the hierarchy.
# FileLocation: the enum constants are already semantic, but its two private booleans (d, e) are
#   never read anywhere in the tree, so they are left unnamed rather than guessed.
# FastRandom (48-bit LCG): a = the state -> seed ; a() -> getSeed ; the private b(int bits)
#   advances the state and returns the top bits -> nextBits ; b() -> nextBoolean (1 bit) ;
# HashUtils: a(int) -> hash(value) (the xorshift/multiply avalanche), a(int,int) -> hash(x,y)
#   (mixes the two coordinates; GameScreen uses it for deterministic per-tile variation).
# OsfLog: a(String) dumps the JRE/OS/user environment -> logSystemInfo ; b(String) is a println
#   that is skipped on iOS -> print ; c(String)/d(String) map to Gdx.app.log/error -> info/error ;
#   a(Throwable) prints the stack trace, also skipped on iOS -> logException.
# No member here is reached by name: files are addressed by path, the mod override is a plain
# java.io probe, and no serializer stores member names. Renaming cannot change saved data.
